words.name: technique-effects
words.spec: Technique `effects` list (`{"name": <Effect>, "unlock_layer": n, "passive_art": true, "rule": ...}`) attached by fight.py / FighterCompiler when layer >= unlock_layer.
words.decision_reason: Already approved in thien_xu checkpoint (2026-11-27). Both green-furnace-canon (d5 the-furnace-spills-over) and empty-mountain-sutra (d5 the-empty-mountains-answer) attach The Empty Mountain's Answer via `effects`; the runtime Effect itself lives in effects/thuy_vi.effects.json so tv-green-moss-mirror also runs it today.

words.name: heal-overflow
words.spec: In engine.py heal() (line 1592-1600) and the GDScript equivalent, emit a separate event `heal_overflow` whenever `amount > max(0.0, got)` (i.e. `ov = amount - max(0.0, got) > 0`, both partial overshoots where `got > 0` and full-HP / heal_cap ticks where `got <= 0`), carrying `{amount: ov, share: ov / s.hp_max, source?}` (plus `s.cur_ev`). Keep `heal_restored` strictly gated on `got > 0`.
words.gdd_text: Effects rule 5, `heal_overflow`: raised when healing exceeds the target's missing health (`amount`: lost health, `share`: lost share of maximum health); `heal_restored` still fires only when health actually increases.
words.decision_reason: Verified against engine.py:1592-1600 and all heal_restored listeners across design/ and assets/data/combat_effects.json: emitting `heal_restored` on `got == 0` would trigger unscaled pulse-regen side effects every second at 100% HP on `thorn-lullaby` (1.0 c free soul hit/s), `ebb-and-flow` (+2 Water stacks/s), `marrow-to-dew` (+1.5% qi/s), and `swelling-tide-palm` (+1 Tide/s), and bypass `heal_cap` checks. Emitting a separate `heal_overflow` event (mirroring linh lực's `overflow` at engine.py:919) with `share = ov / hp_max` avoids every side effect and makes `The Empty Mountain's Answer` scale-invariant across realms. Until serial step b01 builds `heal_overflow` and swaps in `pending.json`'s `effects` record, `effects/thuy_vi.effects.json` runs the partial-overshoot `heal_restored` approximation.

The Empty Mountain's Answer.rule: Healing lost to your full health is stored as Green, and the Green fades by a tenth each second. When the foe cannot evade or carries 5 or more of your Wood stacks, the Green falls on it as Wood damage, once every 3 s.
The Empty Mountain's Answer.approx: Stores per 2.5 % max-HP overflow (`event.share`) and deals 0.2 c Chaos free hits per unit stored; `decay_share: 0.1` decays 10 %/s.
